text:
alex: Heads up — after the node-driver push last night we've seen a cluster-wide uptick in NCCL connectivity failures for large-batch training in eu-west. ~12% of GPU jobs failed with `NCCL error 11` and peer timeouts.
maria: Confirmed. Symptoms: all failures are on nodes with `nvidia-driver-535` + `cuda-12.2`. nodes with 525 unaffected.
kevin: Can we pin a short-term holdlist for affected pools? I can patch the apt repo policy and add `apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-535` on canary pools.
tia: +1 on canaries. Proposal: create two tiny canary pools per region (2 GPUs each) that we promote/demote. Run upgrade there for 24h before fleet rollout.
sre-oncall: Also need automated detection: if NCCL error rate > 5% for 15m, auto-stop new scheduling onto that driver version and notify pager.
alex: Agreed. Short-term hotfix plan: 1) Add holdlist for 535 on prod pools via automation 2) Roll back eu-west GPU nodes to 525 image 3) Create canary pools and run perf/throughput + inter-node NCCL tests 4) Add driver-version gating to the deployment pipeline.
maria: For rollback, ops playbook snippet: ```sudo apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-535 && sudo apt-get install --reinstall nvidia-driver-525 && systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced``` Tested on staging. Works but needs cordon/drain in k8s.
kevin: I'll add a lockstep matrix doc for future upgrades: kernel x driver x cuda x nccl x container-runtime. Each matrix entry must have a verified canary tag before global rollout.
tia: Cost note: keeping old driver images increases AMI maintenance and patching overhead. We should set a TTL on holdlist entries (e.g., 7 days) and require a post-mortem with regression root cause before extending.
sre-oncall: Telemetry additions: emit `driver_version` label on GPU metrics, track `nccl_errors`, `peer_timeout_count`, and add a dashboard per-driver-version. Also create an alert runbook link in the alert.
automation-bot: deploy-bot created canary pools: `canary-gpu-eu-1` and `canary-gpu-eu-2`. Image pinned to 525. Will run nightly NCCL smoke for 6 hours.
alex: Next steps: (A) Kevin to author the lockstep matrix doc and a gating checklist by EOD. (B) Maria to coordinate rollback in eu-west and open PR for apt hold automation. (C) SRE to add the driver-version labels and alert. (D) Run postmortem if we confirm regression.
maria: I'll also open a quick customer-impact note for support; some long-running jobs may need rescheduling.
kevin: Putting a matrix entry sample in slack: `kernel-5.15 | driver-525 | cuda-11.8 | nccl-2.14 | containerd-1.6` — pass/fail/canary.
tia: Reminder: for private (on-prem) customers we should publish an advisory and provide backported images; they can't always move quickly.
sre-oncall: I'll escalate to infra on-call if canary fails. For now, set maintenance window 0300-0500 UTC tomorrow for the eu-west rollback (low traffic).
alex: Thanks — PRs and docs please reference this thread. :thumbsup:
